# Vulnerabilities govulncheck reports as reachable that we cannot currently fix.
#
# One ID per line. Blank lines and #-comments are ignored. Anything reachable and
# NOT listed here fails CI — so this file is the complete, reviewable record of
# what we are knowingly carrying.
#
# Every entry must say WHY it is here and what would remove it. An entry with no
# route out is a decision to stop caring, which is not the same as an exception.
